name: OsmosisProofling-Bench-ProofNet-NT
description: OsmosisProofling-Bench-ProofNet-NT evaluates a model's ability to generate and/or verify formal or natural-language proofs for theorem-style problems drawn from the ProofNet/NT distribution. It measures reasoning depth, stepwise logical coherence, and correctness of produced proofs rather than surface-level language quality. The benchmark is intended to stress mathematical and logical reasoning capabilities of LLMs.
reputation: Niche academic benchmark focused on theorem proving and logical reasoning; used mainly in specialized research communities.
